name: Grandmaster Modesto “Ding” Llanera
ranks: 7th Dan Escrima/Arnis · 7th Dan Shorin Ryu Karate · Black belts in Shotokan & Aikido
bio: Grandmaster Llanera grew up in Manila on the boundary between two of the city’s biggest crime gangs in Tondo. He witnessed large-scale street battles fought with knives, machetes, bows and improvised weapons — and that lived experience shaped a martial art designed to work in real, violent encounters, not in a competition ring.

Over decades he became an accomplished martial artist across Filipino Martial Arts, multiple styles of Karate, Kung Fu, Aikido, Ju-Jitsu and Boxing — reaching 7th Dan in Escrima/Arnis, 7th Dan in Shorin Ryu Karate, and also holds black belts in Shotokan Karate and Aikido.
Now resident in Ireland, the Grandmaster heads Saykan Combat Systems from the Masters Temple in Bray and travels regularly — by invitation — to teach seminars and instructor courses internationally.
philosophy: “The goal is not to seek conflict, but to develop the confidence to face it wisely.” Learn to control the body before attempting to control a situation. Strength without discipline is dangerous; discipline without humility is incomplete.
